query:
UPDATE session_queued_messages SET
                   state = 'queued',
                   failure_reason = 'CLI submission was not acknowledged; queued for retry',
                   claude_session_id = NULL,
                   pasted_at = NULL,
                   updated_at = datetime('now', 'subsec')
               WHERE state = 'pasted'
                 AND julianday(pasted_at) <= julianday($1)
